symptom: `SHOW ACCESS ON PAGE` / Page section of `SHOW SECURITY MATRIX` reports "no roles" for a restricted page on the **modelsdk** engine (legacy is correct) — under-reports page access, a security-audit hazard
cause: `pageFromGen` never read the page's allowed module roles into `Page.AllowedRoles`, so it defaulted to empty. (The gen `Page` decode is correct — it has the storage-name override `allowedRoles`↔`AllowedModuleRoles`.) The microflow/nanoflow equivalent was fixed separately
insight: Populate `out.AllowedRoles` from the gen `AllowedRolesQualifiedNames()` (mirrors `microflowFromGen`). Fixes both `SHOW ACCESS ON PAGE` and the matrix Page section. Issue #722
